headline: TRUMP 💰 DROPS 📉 MILLIONS 💵 In TECH 🍎 And AI 🤖 DEALS 📜
text:
US Prez 🍊 Donald 🐘 Trump just REVEALED 📜 millions 💰 of dollars 💵 worth of STOCK 📈 trades 🛍️ made during July 🌡️ including massive moves 🏃‍♂️ in Elon 🐺 Musk's 🚀 SpaceX 🛰️ plus tech 🖥️ and AI 🤖 giants 🏔️ like Microsoft 🪟. Official 📑 docs 📜 show between six point five mil 💰 and a whopping thirty one mil 💵 in Microsoft 🪟 shares 📉 were SOLD 💸 on behalf of Trump 🐘 while they also logged PURCHASES 🛒 between one sixty five kay 💵 and four hundred kay 💰. The whole thing 🧩 has everyone 👀 raising eyebrows 🤨 because across over one thousand trades 🔄 shares 📈 were bought 🛍️ and sold 💸 in AI 🤖 company Nvidia 🟢 and software 🧠 firm Palantir 🕵️ a contractor 🛠️ with the US 🇺🇸 defence 🛡️ department 🏛️ and even Immigration 🚧 and Customs 🛃 Enforcement 🧊 the filing 📑 shows. A White 🏠 House 🏛️ spokesperson 🗣️ said Trump's 🐘 stock 📈 and bond 🔗 portfolio 💼 is independently 🧍‍♂️ managed 🧑‍💼 by third 🥉 parties 👥 so no direct 👆 input 🔌 from the big man 🐘 himself or his fam 👨‍👩‍👧.

The spokesperson 🗣️ told the BBC 📻 quote 🔖 Neither President 🐘 Trump nor any member 👤 of his family 👨‍👩‍👧 has any ability 💪 to direct 🧭 influence 🌀 or provide input 📥 regarding how the portfolio 💼 is invested 💰 or when investments 🧾 are bought 🛍️ or sold 💸 unquote 🔖. There are no conflicts ⚔️ of interest 😳 they insisted 🗣️ even though thousands 💰 of dollars were also bought 🛍️ and sold 💸 in SpaceX 🚀 the rocket 🧨 satellite 📡 and AI 🤖 company led by Musk 🐺 who was once in charge ⚡ of the US 🇺🇸 Department 🏛️ of Government 🏛️ Efficiency 📉. SpaceX 🛰️ listed its shares 📈 on the US 🇺🇸 based Nasdaq 📊 stock market in June 🗓️ and its share price 📉 has fluctuated 🌀 since then sharply declining 📉 in July 🌡️ and August ☀️ but it is currently trading fourteen percent 📈 higher than its stock market debut 🎉.

Shares 📉 were also bought 🛍️ and sold 💸 in Tesla ⚡ Musk's 🐺 electric 🚗 vehicle maker 🏭 on behalf of Trump 🐘 who has previously publicly 📣 disclosed thousands 💰 of stock market trades 🔄 since he returned 🔄 to the White 🏠 House 🏛️ in January ❄️ last year 📅. The whole saga 📖 of thousands of stock trades 🔄 tied to Trump 🐘 are raising eyebrows 🤨 because a White 🏠 House 🏛️ spokesperson 🗣️ keeps stressing 🗣️ that the portfolio 💼 gets handled by independent 🧍‍♂️ third 🥉 party managers 🧑‍💼 with zero input 🔌 from Trump 🐘 or his relatives 👨‍👩‍👧 meaning no conflicts ⚔️ of interest 😳 whatsoever. Yet the filings 📑 keep showing these huge swings 💰 between six point five and thirty one million 💵 in Microsoft 🪟 alone plus moves 🏃‍♂️ in Nvidia 🟢 Palantir 🕵️ SpaceX 🚀 and Tesla ⚡ all while the prez 🐘 stays hands off 🙌 according to the official 🧾 line. Bro 🧔 the numbers 📊 are so big they make your eyes water 💧 and the fact it involves Musk's 🐺 empire 🏰 just adds extra spice 🌶️ to the whole situation 🧩.

Official 📑 documents 📜 confirm the trades 🛍️ happened during July 🌡️ with Microsoft 🪟 seeing the biggest action 💥 by far as Trump 🐘 apparently DUMPED 💸 between six point five mil 💰 and thirty one mil 💵 while scooping up smaller amounts between one sixty five kay and four hundred kay 💵 in fresh shares 📈. Over one thousand separate trades 🔄 touched AI 🤖 powerhouse Nvidia 🟢 and the controversial 🕵️ software firm Palantir 🕵️ which works hand in glove 🧤 with the defence 🛡️ department 🏛️ and ICE 🧊 on contracts 🧾. A White 🏠 House 🏛️ spokesperson 🗣️ doubled down 🗣️ that the portfolio 💼 runs completely independently 🧍‍♂️ by outsiders 👥 so Trump 🐘 and family 👨‍👩‍👧 cannot direct 🧭 influence 🌀 or even suggest 📢 what gets bought 🛍️ or sold 💸 at any time ⏰.

SpaceX 🚀 trades 🛍️ also popped up in the filing 📑 with thousands 💰 of dollars 💵 worth of stock 📈 changing hands 🤝 for the rocket 🧨 satellite 📡 and AI 🤖 outfit that Musk 🐺 used to lead in government efficiency 📉 before it listed on Nasdaq 📊 back in June 🗓️. The share price 📉 tanked 📉 hard in July 🌡️ and August ☀️ but has since bounced back 📈 to sit fourteen percent higher than its debut 🎉 price. Tesla ⚡ saw similar action 🏃‍♂️ with buys 🛍️ and sells 💸 happening on behalf of the president 🐘 who has been dropping these financial disclosures 📜 like clockwork 🕰️ since returning to the White 🏠 House 🏛️ last January ❄️. The spokesperson 🗣️ insisted again there are zero conflicts ⚔️ of interest 😳 because third 🥉 parties 👥 run the show 🎪 with no input 🔌 allowed from Trump 🐘 or anyone in his circle 👥.
